extDescription.message: Signs you into the systems without single sign-on by filling their sign-in forms with your accounts kept in Casdoor.

signInIntro.message: Casdoor fills the sign-in forms of the systems your admin has set up, with your accounts kept in Casdoor.

managedNotice.message: Your organization has set the Casdoor server for this browser.

applicationHint.message: The Casdoor application you sign in with, ask your admin if unsure. Use owner/name for an application of another organization.

signInCancelled.message: The sign-in window was closed before it finished.

redirectBody.message: This build is not the one from the Chrome Web Store, so add this URL to the redirect URLs of the application first.

autofillOn.message: Sign-in forms are filled when you open them

autofillOff.message: Off, use Fill now on a sign-in page

basicBody.message: This Casdoor fills your managed accounts into the Signin URL of their applications. The Enterprise edition adds sign-in page rules, captchas and saving accounts.

emptyBody.message: When your admin turns on form autofill for a system and gives you an account, it shows up here.

siteSaveOnFirst.message: Saves your account when you sign in

selectorMissing.message: The $1 set by your admin ($2) is not on this page, so it was found automatically.

chooseAccountBody.message: You have more than one account here. The one you pick is used next time.

noFormBody.message: This page of $1 has no sign-in form to fill.

cameBackBody.message: $1 came back to its sign-in page right after the last automatic sign-in, so it was not submitted again. Check the account in Casdoor.

refusedBody.message: The username or password may be wrong. It was not tried again, so that the account doesn't get locked. Check the account in Casdoor.

captchaCrossOrigin.message: The captcha picture comes from another site and can't be read.

captchaGaveUpBody.message: The captcha was read $1 times without success.

saveBody.message: Casdoor will sign you in as $1 next time.

savedBody.message: You'll be signed in to $1 automatically.

devtoolsTitle.message: Close the developer tools to sign in

devtoolsBody.message: To keep your account safe, no password is filled on this sign-in page while the developer tools are open. It is filled as soon as they are closed. If they aren't open, close the browser's side panel.
